question:
A paper is folded and cut as shown. How will it appear when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5537f2cd1af8aa3b8fd3f7b0e4417b087a8cc31c646fe077a61326eba3231c78.png]
solution:
In order to get the complete unfolded pattern we have to unfold the paper one by one in the order it was folded,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11959dbe268ec1a2056da665f90fe09ef872ff701b4fcbd8ec77dc21fbe38e65.png] 

Here we get the completely unfolded paper and the pattern on it and the pattern matches with option 3.

Hence **the correct answer is option 3).**
